title: A look at Candy Crush's continued popularity 15 years after its launch, with an estimated 81.5M MAUs and in-app revenue of $876.5M in fiscal year 2025 (Alanna Okun/Bloomberg)
summary: Alanna Okun / Bloomberg: A look at Candy Crush's continued popularity 15 years after its launch, with an estimated 81.5M MAUs and in-app revenue of $876.5M in fiscal year 2025 — Fifteen years in, those shiny sweets are still on top. — Johanna Chouraqui doesn't time travel anymore.
